blocks.content: The box is ready. Now you need to put text inside it.
Canvas text works through ctx.fillText(). Before you draw anything, set the alignment so the text centers correctly inside the box:

ctx.textAlign = "center";     // x is the horizontal center of the text
ctx.textBaseline = "middle";  // y is the vertical center of the text
These two lines persist across calls. Set them once at the top of each overlay method and all your text draws will align consistently.
Then draw each line with its own font and color:
Use a larger bolder font for the title. Smaller and lighter for instructions. The contrast between the two makes the screen feel structured without needing any layout work.
The pause overlay follows the same pattern. Same box, same alignment, different text.
Next, you will build all three overlays and wire them into the draw loop.
